errors.text_span: with a peak of around 2.2 Euro/MWh in July 2024
errors.evidence: The peak of the line graph occurs in April/May 2024, not in July 2024. The value in July is lower than the initial peak.

errors.text_span: ending at around -5.5 Euro/MWh in February 2025
errors.evidence: The graph clearly shows the line ending at approximately -2 Euro/MWh in February 2025. The value -5.5 Euro/MWh is closer to the minimum value reached in late January/early February, not the final ending value.
The description does not mention the prominent black horizontal line at the y-value of 0, which serves as an important visual reference point for where the value becomes negative.

errors.text_span: ending at around -5.5 Euro/MWh in February 2025, with a notable spike to around -2 Euro/MWh at the very end of the graph.
errors.evidence: This sentence is contradictory. The line cannot both end at -5.5 Euro/MWh and have a spike to -2 Euro/MWh at the very end. The spike *is* the end of the graph, and the final value is approximately -2 Euro/MWh.
